name.value: Day To Day Express Grocery & Produce

description.value: Day To Day Grocery & Produce is a South Asian wholesale cash-and-carry grocery chain established in 2020 under Guruji Foods Inc., specializing in products from the South Asian region including premium basmati rice, ayurvedic herbs, exotic spices, and fresh produce. The chain positions itself as one of the largest South Asian grocery operations in the Lower Mainland, carrying over 5,000 products across groceries, kitchenware, and homeware under one roof.
